verdict.rationale: The portal documents acting "em representação" (on someone else's behalf) for electronic notifications and citations, and it has a dedicated services area for Contabilistas Certificados. Together these point to a sanctioned third-party rail through which a professional can act for a company, but the evidence is only homepage-level snippets. missing for 10: documentation of how a company appoints or authorizes a representative or certified accountant, the scope of what designees may do beyond notifications, revocation and management of delegations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Adira às notificações e citações eletrónicas em nome próprio ou em representação.
